usageNotes: Permanently deletes a named QEMU VM snapshot and its associated disk delta layers; requires `VM.Snapshot` privilege on `/vms/{vmid}`. The operation is asynchronous — the return value is a task UPID that should be polled to confirm completion before assuming the snapshot is gone. Use `force: true` only as a last resort when disk snapshot removal is failing but you still need the config entry cleared.

examples.summary: Delete the 'pre-update' snapshot from VM 102 on node pve1

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named snapshot and its disk delta data; the VM state captured at that point-in-time cannot be recovered after deletion.
tips: The returned UPID string can be passed to the task status endpoint (GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status) to poll for completion.
Deleting a snapshot while the VM is running is supported but may take longer as disk merging occurs live.
Child snapshots that depend on the deleted snapshot's disk delta will be rebased automatically by Proxmox — verify snapshot tree integrity afterward.
Avoid using `force` in production; it can leave orphaned disk data on storage backends that support external snapshots (e.g., Ceph RBD).
